VERIFY list:

- MO-ALC-D-ADMINCHART — administrative action chart layout partly lost in extraction (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- MO-ALC-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- MO-ALC-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: fines, jail ranges, suspension lengths, BAC limits and reinstatement fees (sec12-F14 to sec12-F21 and sec12-F33 to sec12-F38) are statutory and can change; the interlock installer list and the helpline details are agency contacts that must be refreshed from official sources.
